clips.send: A trader sends this to a friend who trusts the Forbes list, pure anger at being lied to about who really runs the money.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the Forbes 400 list is not what it claims to be.

Two people arrested in Asia this year had crypto wallets worth $17 billion and $50 billion in cash, more than most names on that list. Neither of them made the cut.

As he puts it, quoting J. Paul Getty: it is not how much money you have, it is how much money you control. Norway's sovereign wealth fund alone holds $2 trillion. Saudi Arabia's holds $1.7 trillion. Almost nobody can name who actually controls either one.

The richest list you have ever seen might be missing its richest people.
